//: Route matrix for scripts/ci/render-smoke.mjs. Keep it small enough to gate every PR; the wide sweep belongs in a scheduled job.
//routes: Locale-relative. Expanded against every locale above.
//absentNamespaces: The scoping invariant. A namespace listed here must NOT reach this route's payload. Environment-independent: it compares against a sentinel string taken from messages/en, so it does not care how much seeded content CI has. If the layout ever goes back to shipping the whole catalog, every one of these fails at once.
//knownBroken: Pre-existing raw key paths on main, verified live on production 2026-08-26 (44 on the cabinet guide, 1 on permits). Prefixes, not exact strings, because the set shifts slightly with seeded content. This list may only SHRINK — deleting an entry is the fix landing. Any key path NOT covered here fails the build.

knownBroken.//siteVisit: The `severity` enum is stored INSIDE messages/<locale>/siteVisit.json, and the MT pipeline translated its values: blocker->阻挡者, high->高的 (and the equivalent in 12 other locales). The component does t(`ui.${item.severity}`), so the lookup misses and the raw path renders. message-parity cannot see this — it compares KEYS, this is a VALUE. Fix is mechanical: restore the English enum values in all 13 non-EN catalogs, then delete these two entries.

//extraRoutes: Not locale-expanded. The two known-broken pages are here so the allowlist is exercised and shrinks visibly when someone fixes the keys.
